name: ranger_slide_hill
description: Ranger slide on 45-degree slope. NOTE: requires slope geometry not in the basic level. Tests terrain-following if slope surface exists. Uses S3 (L=550) aimed at the hill region.
script: # The standard level has a flat floor at y=500. The hill is BELOW the floor.
# This test verifies the slide mechanic on the floor with a longer arc,
# then checks if terrain-following works if the ranger slides off an edge.
# (Full hill slope test requires polygon collision bodies.)
# Use S5 (L=750) — longest rope, steepest angle at floor impact
announce S5: Longest rope (L=750) — steep impact angle
# Swing RIGHT hard — build maximum momentum
announce Swinging right — maximum momentum build
# Steep floor impact — most velocity goes into the surface normal.
# The blue (surface-parallel) component is smallest for S5.
# But the total velocity is highest (longest drop).
announce Circle to SLIDE — steep angle, slow horizontal slide
announce SLIDING — full 2s charge for maximum boost
announce Release Circle — FULL CHARGE (1.5x) boost!
notify {SCRIPT} "Did ranger slide with steep angle and full-charge boost?" ["YES","NO","PARTIAL"] {inspect} blocking
